bridgeCurrentPlanning.basis: Use the related ASM2464PD as a sizing reference and retain 3 A design loads for the PDX VCCL and VDD rails. Similar current demand is an engineering assumption, not a confirmed PDX specification.
bridgeCurrentPlanning.referenceDocument: ASMedia ASM2464PD datasheet revision 0.4, May 5, 2023, sections 6.2 and 6.3.12, pages 15 and 18
bridgeCurrentPlanning.limitations: The PDX uses a nominal 1.13 V core supply. The PD table does not establish PDX current limits or transient demand. Its VCCH figure varies with GPIO use and gives no separate VCCA33 current. Budget other 3.3 V loads separately. Keep PDX voltage limits and all existing voltage-drop checks; validate startup, ripple, load response and temperatures on prototype hardware.

localContactNote: Short BGA and capacitor contacts use fine geometry where the pad pitch prevents a 15 mil track. Broad regions carry the main rail current. The emitted-copper DC screen checks these contacts as part of each supply path.

projectDcScreen.scope: Actual top copper, both assigned inner power regions, and plated via barrels.

qualification.note: The 3 A load is the project screening envelope, not an ASMedia current specification. The current layout exceeds the separate 8 mV project screen; actual-load voltage qualification remains open. Package losses, ground return, capacitor impedance, unequal ball currents, ripple and load steps require separate qualification.
